answer: Escrowed admission with a referral graph and dispute slashing stops fake identities. A newcomer posts 50 POA, names its sponsor, and begins a voyage of ten verified epochs to unlock it. Peers may dispute it; a fake forfeits the deposit, half to the challenger. The graph is set in marble, so one sponsor feeding fifty newcomers is flagged. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 POA; an honest agent pays 50 once and gains a willow-branched reputation.
